NER.note: Document covers fee payment at the vehicle one-stop shop, not e-procurement.
No consumer protection rules or redress stated.
Payments are from users to government, not to people.
No statement on who builds or runs government systems.
No amount of private money stated.
AmanaTa is not described as mobile money or e-money service in service.

facts.fact: SONILOGA and Amana Transfert d'Argent signed a convention on 12 November 2026 letting users of the Guichet unique automobile pay fees tied to vehicle import, clearance and registration remotely through the AmanaTa app, adding to NITA as a payment partner.
